prompts: Words are tied to each other, and nobody here can see how. {WS}/site is a saved copy of a Portuguese creative dictionary. Explore this universe of words: collect what the site knows and build {WS}/universe/index.html, a single file that sums the universe up in one view and lets someone search for a word and find how it relates to others. The best way to show it is your call, and that view is what we care about most. So people can share a word, opening the page with ?word=saudade must show that word and its relations. Save the data as {WS}/words.json, mapping each word to the words it is linked to, and record in {WS}/result.json: words (how many), relations (how many distinct pairs) and most_connected. It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js.
answers:
**[goal]** Sum the Portuguese creative-dictionary universe into one searchable, shareable view.

**[action]** Parsed all 256 pages in `./site` (252 word pages + index + sobre/contato excluded as non-words). Each word page carries a title, a theme, and two link sections (Sinônimos, Palavras análogas). I extracted every link, normalized to lowercase NFC, dropped links to non-existent pages (e.g. `rascunho-3`), and built:
- `./words.json` — each word mapped to its linked words (252 entries).
- `./universe/index.html` — single file, no build step. A 3D star map (three.js from the allowed jsdelivr CDN) where each word is a star sized by degree, links are lines, drag/zoom/click to explore, a search box with suggestions, and a card showing the word, its theme, and clickable relation chips. `?word=saudade` deep-links straight to that word.
- `./result.json` — `{words: 252, relations: 669, most_connected: "tempo"}`.

**[result]** Verified in a real browser:
- `?word=saudade` renders the card "saudade / SENTIMENTOS / 4 RELAÇÕES: ansiedade, carinho, dor, nostalgia" — matching the source page exactly.
- Stats read "252 palavras · 669 relações".
- Independent recompute from `words.json` confirms 669 distinct undirected pairs and `tempo` as most connected (degree 13, ahead of `palavra` 11).

**[next]** None — deliverables are complete and the browser tab is closed.

Assumptions I made: "words" = the 252 pages with an `<h1>` word title (index/sobre/contato are navigation, not words); "relations" = distinct undirected word-pairs across both link sections; duplicate/self links collapsed; links to missing pages dropped. Most-connected ties would be broken by first occurrence, but `tempo` leads outright.
